chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from ʿUthmān ibn ʿĪsā, from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, who said:

I said: “Do I perform a supererogatory prayer during the time of an obligatory prayer?” He said: “Yes, at the beginning of the time, if you are with an Imam whom you follow. But if you are alone, then begin with the obligatory prayer.”

key_terms.أَوَّلِ الْوَقْتِ: the beginning part of the appointed prayer time
key_terms.إِمَامٍ: the prayer leader whom one follows in congregational salat

ai.seo_question: Can one perform a nafilah prayer during the time of an obligatory salat?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about performing a nafilah prayer during the time of an obligatory salat. It permits doing so at the beginning of the prayer time when one is with an Imam being followed, while instructing a person praying alone to begin with the obligatory prayer first.
